_readme: ThetaDriven per-agent licence key. The seed_hex field at the bottom is a PRIVATE key — treat it like an SSH private key: never commit it, never paste it into a shared channel. Everything else in this file is public and safe to hand to a verifier.
purpose: issued by the operator and recorded on the licence tape
agent_key_derivation: HKDF-SHA256(seed = seed_hex, salt = "thetadriven-agent-v1", info = agent_id) → that agent's own ed25519 seed. One licence key derives every agent identity offline; you never send us an agent key.
